ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation VAR++ LAUNCHER OBFUSCATION
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via VAR++ LAUNCHER

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\&\\&set.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/c.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-f.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\{0\\}.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\{1\\}.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\{2\\}.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\{3\\}.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\{4\\}.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\{5\\}.*")))
